resources.string: No connection to CareLink. Check the internet and try again.
CareLink did not answer as expected. Try again later.
This CareLink region uses another way of signing in, which the app cannot do yet.
The sign-in could not be saved on this phone. Try again after unlocking it.
Sign-in did not finish. Close this window and try again.
The built-in browser (Android System WebView) is not available on this phone. Turn on or update Android System WebView in Google Play and try again.
Warnings: pump data is not coming in or not saved
The CareLink sign-in has stopped working, so pump data is not coming in. Open the CareLink window in the app and sign in again.
No pump data for over %1$d min
No new data has come from the pump. Check that the pump is near the phone and Bluetooth is on, and open the pump window. The active insulin in the app may be old; check the pump.
For %1$d min pump records have not reached the app\'s journal. Open the pump window and tap Read again under Diagnostics; if it repeats, restart the app.
MiniMed pump over Bluetooth: pairing, data, settings
Sign in so that pump boluses, basal and active insulin come to the app.
The CareLink sign-in has stopped working. Sign in again: pump data for roughly the last day will be filled in, earlier data will not.
Pump data is not coming in because automatic updates are off. Tap \"Turn updates on\".

Signed in. The first data usually comes within 1–2 minutes. If there is still none after 10 minutes, check that MiniMed Mobile is running and sees the pump. If there is no data for longer than the chosen time, you will get a notification.
Pump data is out of date
The newest pump data came %1$s. Check that MiniMed Mobile is running and sees the pump. The numbers below are old.
Data received but not saved to the journal
No connection to CareLink. Check the internet.
CareLink answered with error %1$d. It usually passes by itself; if there is no data for longer than the chosen time, you will get a notification.
The CareLink answer does not look like pump data.
The saved sign-in could not be opened. Unlock the phone; if it repeats, sign out and sign in again.
The CareLink answer could not be read.
The app\'s journal did not take the boluses and carbs from CareLink. Tap \"Update now\"; if it repeats, restart the app.
User name and password are typed on the Medtronic page; the app does not see them.

Pump data will stop coming in, and so will the warnings about it. Records already in the journal stay. To get the data back you will need to sign in to CareLink again with your Medtronic user name and password.
How many minutes without pump data, or with records not saved to the journal, before a notification.
Pump data reaches CareLink a few minutes late, and the update runs every %1$d min. A warning sooner than %2$d min may come even when all is well.
Pump boluses go to the journal with this insulin type: the app works out its own active insulin by it.
Record carbs from the pump calculator
Carbs entered in the pump calculator go to the journal with their bolus.
New pump records go to Nightscout, and to LibreView if sending to it is on. Older records are not sent. The Nightscout setting \"Send insulin and carbs\" must be on too.
Otherwise Android may delay the link to the pump and its warnings.
So that the warnings can reach you: \"No pump data for over %1$d min\", \"Pump records are not saved\", \"The phone forgot the pump\" and others.
The pump channel is turned off in the phone settings, so no warnings will come. Tap to turn it on.
The system settings of the pump notifications.
